basis: Taxable income (long-term gains are stacked on top of other taxable income)
note: Long-term capital gains (assets held more than one year) are taxed at 0% up to the zero-rate amount, 15% up to the 15-percent rate amount, and 20% above it. Short-term gains are taxed as ordinary income using the federal income tax brackets. These are the exact thresholds used by the CryptoTaxAI calculators.
source: IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-32, Section 4.03 (maximum zero rate and maximum 15 percent rate amounts under IRC § 1(h) / § 1(j)(5))
